prose: The friend to the fairies and painter of pixies, Izzy Ivy, joins us to talk about visionary art, oracle decks, and opening to the spirit world. Izzy creates transcendental oil paintings depicting mystical beings and cosmic harmony.
topics: Beyond Lemuria, Izzy’s second oracle deck
The galactic central sun and our inner central sun
ext: Fusing modalities and rituals to make Reiki more effective
The physical and spiritual sides of shadow work
